_comment: Maps an article slug to the permalink WordPress actually returned.
Written ONLY from the 'link' field of a posts.create/update response.
Never predicted: this site serves posts at /YYYY/MM/DD/{slug}/, and the
date segment is assigned by WordPress at publish time.
build-article.mjs resolves internal cross-links through this file and
refuses to emit an unresolved one unless --allow-unresolved is passed,
which is only correct for the first publish of a not-yet-existing article.
